ARCHETYPE.APPLY_HINT: Skills, talents, gear and Wounds are granted as starting, so they cost no XP and count for no allegiance.
ARCHETYPE.STUBS: Not in any compendium, added as blanks
ARCHETYPE.ABILITY.CHAMPION: Leading by Example: when an ally the champion can see spends an Infamy Point, the champion may, as a Free Action, let that ally spend it as though the ally had the champion's Corruption and allegiance.
ARCHETYPE.ABILITY.CHOSEN: Cold-Blooded Killer: when the chosen attacks in a fit of Fanatical Hatred, he may reroll a rolled critical result. The second result stands.
ARCHETYPE.ABILITY.FORSAKEN: Resourceful: the forsaken gains +10 to Infamy tests made to acquire an item of Rare or more common Availability.
ARCHETYPE.ABILITY.SORCERER: Sorcerer: gains the Psyker trait, Psy Rating 2 and 1 Corruption Point. Counts as a bound psyker when working out Psychic Strength.
ARCHETYPE.ABILITY.APOSTATE: Serpent's Tongue: once per session the apostate may make a Challenging (+0) Charm or Deceive test to gain the Peer talent with an organisation of his choice until the end of the session. With Fellowship 55 or higher he gains Peer (2) instead.
ARCHETYPE.ABILITY.HERETEK: Traitor of Mars: gains the Mechanicus Implants trait and two good craftsmanship cybernetics of his choice, plus the Binary Chatter trait, which raises the loyalty of every servitor or cybernetic servant by +10.
ARCHETYPE.ABILITY.RENEGADE: Gifted: choose one characteristic at creation. The renegade always gains one extra degree of success on every successful test tied to it, characteristic and skill tests alike.
ARCHETYPE.ABILITY.PSYKER: Chaos Psyker: an unsanctioned psyker. Gains the Psyker trait, Psy Rating 3 and 1d5 Corruption Points, and counts as an unbound psyker when working out Psychic Strength.
ALLEGIANCE.COUNTED: Counted from the sheet: characteristics, skills, talents and psychic powers
ALLEGIANCE.MANUAL: Manual correction, kept through every recount
ALLEGIANCE.NOTE: Five advances clear of every other god shifts allegiance at the next 10 Corruption.
PSY.KHORNE_FORBIDS: Sworn to Khorne — the Blood God suffers no witchery.

WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.accurate: +10 to hit when Aiming, and an Aimed single shot from a ranged weapon adds +1d10 damage per two degrees of success (up to +2d10).
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.balanced: +10 to Weapon Skill Tests made to Parry with this weapon.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.blast: Everything within X metres of the hit is struck as well; the system rolls the blast out over the targets in range.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.concussive: The target tests Toughness at -10 per X; on a failure it is Stunned for one round per degree of failure, and is knocked Prone if the damage beat its Strength Bonus.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.crippling: Announced in the chat card when the hit deals Wounds: acting beyond a Half Action costs the target X Rending damage, ignoring armour and Toughness. Tracking it is the GM's job.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.defensive: -10 to attack with this weapon, +15 when Parrying with it.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.devastating: A hit on a Horde reduces its Magnitude by an extra X.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.felling: Ignores X points of the target's Unnatural Toughness when damage is worked out.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.flame: Anyone struck tests Agility automatically, even for no damage; on a failure the system sets them On Fire.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.flexible: This weapon cannot be Parried - the system blocks the Parry outright. It can still be used to Parry.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.force: In a psyker's hands the weapon adds his Psy Rating to both damage and penetration.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.gyroStabilised: Targets never count as further away than Long range: the -30 Extreme range penalty is lifted to -10.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.hallucinogenic: A living target tests Toughness at -10 per X; on a failure the system rolls the hallucination and reports the result and its duration.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.haywire: Announced in the chat card: an electromagnetic field X metres across, weakening one step each round. The GM resolves its effect on machinery.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.inaccurate: Aiming grants no bonus with this weapon.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.lasSetting: Adds a firing-mode picker to the attack dialog: Overcharge (+1 damage, twice the charge) or Maximal (+2 damage, +2 Penetration, four times the charge, Reliable becomes Unreliable). Laslocks and hot-shot weapons do not get it.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.maximal: Adds a Maximal checkbox to the attack dialog: +10 metres range, +1d10 damage, +2 Penetration, and Blast increased by 2.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.melta: Doubles Penetration at Short range or closer.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.overheats: On an unmodified 91 or higher the weapon overheats instead of jamming, and the system warns the wielder.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.powerField: Recognised on the sheet and shown in the chat card, but destroying the parried weapon is not automated - roll it at the table.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.primitive: Any damage die higher than X counts as X. Righteous Fury still triggers on a natural 10.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.proven: Any damage die lower than X counts as X.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.razorSharp: At three or more degrees of success on the attack, Penetration is doubled for that attack's hits.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.recharge: One shot per round: the system blocks the next attack until the following round has passed.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.reliable: Jams only on an unmodified 100 instead of 96+.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.sanctified: Marks the damage as Holy. The system only records it - what it means against a given daemon is the GM's call.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.scatter: Point Blank: +10 to hit and +3 damage. Short range: +10 to hit. Longer ranges: -3 damage.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.shock: A target that takes damage tests Toughness (+0) automatically; on a failure the system applies Stunned for rounds equal to the degrees of failure.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.smoke: Announced in the chat card: a screen X metres across for 1d10+10 rounds. Placing it on the scene is the GM's job.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.snare: The target tests Agility at -10 per X or is Snared and counts as Helpless until it breaks free.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.spray: No attack roll at all: everyone in the cone tests Agility or is hit.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.storm: Doubles the hits scored and the ammunition spent.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.tainted: The weapon feeds on the wielder's Corruption: it adds the tens digit of his Corruption points to damage.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.tearing: Rolls one extra damage die and drops the lowest.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.toxic: A target that takes damage tests Toughness at -10 per X; on a failure the system deals another 1d10 damage that armour and Toughness do not reduce.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.twinLinked: The paired weapons fire together: twice the ammunition per attack and an extra hit at two or more degrees of success.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.twinLinkedBonus: The variant that grants +10 to hit instead of the extra hit. Use this entry or plain Twin-Linked, never both.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.unbalanced: -10 to the defender's Parry against this weapon, and it cannot be used for a Lightning Attack.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.unreliable: Jams on 91 or higher instead of 96+.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.unwieldy: Cannot Parry, and cannot be used for a Lightning Attack.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.vengeful: Righteous Fury triggers on a damage die of X or higher, not only on a 10.
WEAPON.QUALITY_HINT.warpWeapon: The damage strikes through matter: armour does not protect against it.

VEHICLE.CREW_INITIATIVE_SET: Initiative {value} from {name} given to {count} combatant(s). Order within the crew stays yours to arrange.

VEHICLE.CREW_BAD_TYPE: Only characters and NPCs can be seated aboard a vehicle.

VEHICLE.BLOCKED.UNPOWERED: No power — this weapon needs the vehicle running.
VEHICLE.POWERED_HINT: An unpowered vehicle cannot traverse, feed or fire this weapon.
VEHICLE.CLIP_FULL: That weapon is already fully loaded.
VEHICLE.ARC_WARN: {name} covers {arc}° to the {facing}, and the target is not in it. Fire anyway?
VEHICLE.CHAT.DETONATION: Something cooks off — 8 Critical Damage to the hull.
VEHICLE.CHAT.DETONATION_EXPLOSIVE: The fuel goes up — 8 Critical Damage to the hull. Anyone caught in the blast tests Agility (−10) or catches fire.
VEHICLE.CREW_DROP_HINT: Drag an actor here to seat them.

VEHICLE.RAM_FLAVOR: {name} rams {victim}: 1d10 + {armour} armour of the striking side, +1d10 per full 10 m driven beyond the Tactical Speed of {tactical} m ({runUp} m driven). The target is pushed {push} m. Recoil taken: {recoil}.
VEHICLE.RAM_RUN_UP: Metres driven this round before the ram (Tactical Speed and beyond)
VEHICLE.NO_PINTLE_GUNNER: Select the token of whoever mans the pintle, or assign a gunner.
VEHICLE.NO_MANOEUVRE_WALKER: A walker cannot do that on legs alone.
VEHICLE.NO_MANOEUVRE_CLOSED: Only an open-topped vehicle can strike from the saddle.
VEHICLE.MANOEUVRE_PENALTY: {name}: {penalty} to attacks against the vehicle, and to shooting from it, until the operator acts again.
VEHICLE.MANOEUVRE_UNMANAGEABLE: Failed by {dof} degrees — the vehicle goes Unmanageable. Roll on the Directions table.
VEHICLE.MANOEUVRE_CLEAR: Click to clear the declared manoeuvre
VEHICLE.NO_RAM_WALKER: A walker cannot ram — it charges instead.
VEHICLE.RAM_MISSED: The Operate test fails — no collision.
VEHICLE.NO_RAM_IMMOBILE: It is not going anywhere, let alone into something.
WEAPON.FLEXIBLE_NO_PARRY: {weapon} is Flexible and cannot be Parried.
WEAPON.TRAIT.TOXIC_DAMAGE: Toxic: {damage} additional Damage, not reduced by armour or Toughness.
WEAPON.TRAIT.HALLUCINOGENIC_RESULT: Hallucinogenic: rolled {roll} on Table 5-1, effect lasts {rounds} Round(s). A respirator or sealed armour grants +20 to the Test.
WEAPON.TRAIT.CRIPPLED: Crippled: taking more than a Half Action inflicts {damage} Rending Damage, not reduced by armour or Toughness. Lasts until the end of the encounter or until healed of all Damage.
WEAPON.TRAIT.SMOKE_CLOUD: Smoke: a screen {radius} metres across for 1d10+10 Rounds.
WEAPON.TRAIT.HAYWIRE_FIELD: Haywire: a {radius} metre field — roll 1d100 on Table 5-2, the strength lessens one step each Round.
WEAPON.MAXIMAL_HINT: +10 range, +1d10 Damage, +2 Penetration, Blast improved by +2.
WEAPON.RECHARGE_WAIT: {weapon} must spend this Round recharging and cannot be fired.
RACE.MISMATCH: {archetype} requires the {race} race — the archetype and the race disagree.
RACE.SPACE_MARINE_NOTE: The Astartes implants also grant Traits (p. 50). The book lists them in prose, organ by organ, so they are not handed out automatically — add them by hand.
AMMUNITION.FITS_HINT: Nothing ticked — fits any weapon, as standard ammunition does.
SETTINGS.RULESET_HINT: Heretic sheets always use Black Crusade rules and acolyte sheets always use Dark Heresy 2 rules. This setting decides which rules apply to actors that have no game of their own.
ORIGIN.NAME: Origin Name
ORIGIN.NO_GRANTS: This origin grants nothing on its own.
WIZARD.TITLE: Character Creation — {name}
WIZARD.SHOP_MATCH_HINT: Aptitudes this purchase shares with the character. Two is cheapest.
WIZARD.EQUIPMENT_RULE: On top of your background gear, take items from the Armoury up to your starting Influence bonus, each of Scarce availability or better (p. 82). Weapons come with two clips of standard ammunition.
WIZARD.EQUIPMENT_FULL: Your Influence bonus allows {allowance} picks, and they are all taken.
WIZARD.SHOP_REFUND_PSYCHIC_FIRST: Refund the psychic powers and psy rating first: they depend on this advance.
WIZARD.OWED_RULE: An aptitude came twice. Take a characteristic aptitude you do not have instead (p. 79). Buying waits until this is settled.
WIZARD.RESOLVE_APTITUDES_FIRST: Settle the aptitudes that came twice before buying anything.
WIZARD.ELITE_PSYKER_RULES: Gains the Psyker trait, the Psyker aptitude and psy rating 1. A psyker who is not Sanctioned also gains 1d10+3 Corruption; a Sanctioned one starts at psy rating 2. Unlocks psychic powers and psy rating advances. Cannot become Untouchable.
WIZARD.ELITE_UNTOUCHABLE_RULES: Gains Resistance (Psychic Powers). Fellowship counts as half its value, or 1 against anyone with a psy rating or Psyniscience. Never benefits from psychic powers, ignores Psychic Phenomena and gets +30 to resist Perils of the Warp. Cannot become a psyker.
WIZARD.ELITE_GM: Elite advances need the GM's permission (p. 87). One granted by an origin comes free.
WIZARD.SHOP_NOT_ENOUGH: That costs {cost} and only {remaining} is left.
WIZARD.SHOP_PREREQUISITES: The character does not meet this talent's prerequisites.
WIZARD.SHOP_REFUND_TOP_FIRST: Refund the higher rank first: ranks are bought in turn.
WIZARD.SPEND_HINT: Costs are cumulative: a rank must be bought before the one above it. Spend the pool on the character sheet.
WIZARD.UNRESOLVED_GRANTS: No compendium carries these, so they were added as empty placeholders: {names}
WIZARD.BLESSING_GRANTED: Emperor's Blessing: rolled {rolled} against {threshold}+ — Fate threshold raised by 1.
WIZARD.BLESSING_MISSED: Emperor's Blessing: rolled {rolled} against {threshold}+ — no increase.
WIZARD.START_HINT: Create a character sheet and open the creation wizard on it.
WIZARD.NO_GM: No Gamemaster is online to create the character.
WIZARD.ASKING_GM: Asking the Gamemaster to create the sheet…
WIZARD.WRONG_TYPE: This book builds a different kind of sheet. Ask your Gamemaster to create one of the right type.
WIZARD.DIVINATION_HINT: Every character rolls once on the Divinations table for the fate that shaped them.
WIZARD.NO_DIVINATION_TABLE: The Divinations table is missing. Build the tables pack first.
WIZARD.CHAR_LOCKED: Characteristics, wounds and fate are set. Go Back to generate them again.
WIZARD.UNAUDITED: Not yet available, because their creation rules have not been checked against the book:
GIFT.THRESHOLD: Gift of the Gods threshold reached
GIFT.ROLL_HINT: Roll on Gifts of the Gods in the Black Crusade Tables compendium.
GIFT.NO_MALIGNANCY: Black Crusade has no Malignancy test. Corruption is spent at Gift of the Gods thresholds instead.
INSANITY.NO_TRAUMA: Black Crusade has no Trauma test. Heretics already count as fully insane and gain Disorders instead.
EFFECTS.BLEEDING_STAUNCH: Once per round as a Free Action, this character or someone who can reach him may attempt a Difficult (-10) Medicae test to remove Blood Loss.
EFFECTS.FIRE_PANIC: Willpower test failed: this turn the character can only flail and scream, which counts as a Full Action.
EFFECTS.SUFFOCATION_OUT_OF_AIR: Out of air: the character falls Unconscious regardless of Fatigue.
EFFECTS.PINNED_RULES: A Pinned character may take only one Half Action per turn and suffers -20 to Ballistic Skill tests. He must stay in or move to cover. Melee combat ends Pinning automatically.
EFFECTS.VACUUM_IGNORES: Decompression and cold ignore both Armour and Toughness Bonus.
ENVIRONMENT.TITLE: Environment
WEAPON.TRAIT.TOXIC_PENDING: Toxic ({value}): the Toughness test comes at the start of the target's next turn.
WEAPON.TRAIT.TOXIC_RESOLVED: Toxic resolved. Damage from the toxin ignores both Armour and Toughness Bonus.
WEAPON.TRAIT.TOXIC_MANUAL: Poisoned was applied by hand, so there is no toxin strength on record - resolve it at the table.
CONDITION.DEAFENED_WARNING: Deafened: this test automatically fails if it relies on hearing.

RULESET.CHARACTER_HINT: Which book this character is played by. Leave it on the sheet type unless the character comes from another line.
SHIP.USED_AUTO: Totalled from the ship's components and weapons.
SHIP.COMPONENT.NAME: Component
SHIP.THRESHOLD.CREW_40: No Achievement Point bonus from components
SHIP.THRESHOLD.CREW_10: No boarding or raids; those tests at a further -20
SHIP.THRESHOLD.MORALE_20: No boarding or raids; 1d5 crew desert in port
SHIP.THRESHOLD.MORALE_10: Command -30 total; Speed, Manoeuvrability and Detection -10
SHIP.THRESHOLD.MORALE_0: The crew has taken the ship
SHIP.CHAT.SHIELDS_COLLAPSED: The void shields have overloaded and are down against this attacker for the rest of the round.
SHIP.CHAT.LANCE_IGNORES_ARMOUR: A lance burns straight through armour and into the hull.
SHIP.CHAT.NO_TARGET: That ship is no longer available.
SHIP.CHAT.NOT_OWNER: You do not have permission to damage that ship.
SHIP.NOTE.NO_TARGET: No target ship was named, so void shields and armour were not applied.
SHIP.NOTE.CRIT_MINIMUM: The shot met its Crit Rating without breaching the hull, so it inflicts 1 point automatically.
SHIP.NOTE.CRIT_NO_TABLE: A Critical Hit was scored, but the starship critical table was not found in the compendium.
SHIP.DIALOG.SALVO_NEEDS_TWO: A salvo needs at least two macrobatteries.
SHIP.CHAT.SALVO_LIGHT_FIRST: The void shields were fed the lightest guns' hits first, as the attacker chooses.
SHIP.NOTE.SALVO_ONE_CRIT: Several batteries met their Crit Rating, but a combined salvo inflicts only one Critical Hit.
SHIP.BRIDGE.RESET: Start a new turn: clears this turn's actions and effects
SHIP.DIALOG.NO_REPAIRABLE: No damaged, unpowered or depressurised component to repair.
SHIP.NOTE.NO_FIRE_DISENGAGE: This ship attempted to disengage this turn and may not fire any weapons.
SHIP.NOTE.HOLD_FAST_TALENT: Hold Fast! requires Air of Authority, or a similar talent at the GM's discretion.
SHIP.NOTE.NOTHING_TO_CANCEL: There was no such damage in the previous turn to cancel.
SHIP.NOTE.NO_COMPONENT: No repairable component was chosen, so nothing was put under repair.
SHIP.TURN.HALF_TURNS: Crippled with its crew below 20: this ship takes a Strategic Turn only every other round.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.ADJUST_BEARING: Challenging (+0) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability. Turn earlier than normal.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.ADJUST_SPEED: Challenging (+0) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability. Move faster or slower than normal.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.ADJUST_SPEED_BEARING: Hard (-20) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability. Turn earlier while moving faster or slower.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.COME_TO_NEW_HEADING: Difficult (-10) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability. Make two turns in one round; -20 to gunnery this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.DISENGAGE: Opposed Challenging (+0) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability against enemies within 20 VU. Not allowed within 8 VU of an enemy. No firing this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.EVASIVE: Difficult (-10) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability. -10 per success to all fire against the ship, and to its own.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.ACTIVE_AUGURY: Challenging (+0) Scrutiny + Detection. Scans the area and reveals ships on silent running.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.AID_MACHINE_SPIRIT: Challenging (+0) Tech-Use. Bonus to Manoeuvrability or Detection for the rest of the turn.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.DISINFORMATION: Difficult (-10) Deceive. Raises Morale for the combat.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.EMERGENCY_REPAIRS: Difficult (-10) Tech-Use. Repairs a damaged, depressurised or unpowered component over several turns.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.FLANK_SPEED: Challenging (+0) Tech-Use. Extra movement; failing by two or more degrees cripples the engines.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.FOCUSED_AUGURY: Challenging (+0) Scrutiny + Detection. Detailed scan of one ship within 20 VU.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.HOLD_FAST: Challenging (+0) Willpower; needs Air of Authority. Cancels Morale damage from the previous turn.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.JAM_COMMUNICATIONS: Difficult (-10) Tech-Use. Stops one ship within range from sending vox signals.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.LOCK_ON_TARGET: Challenging (+0) Scrutiny + Detection. Bonus to the next weapon component fired this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.PREPARE_TO_REPEL: Challenging (+0) Command. Bonus to opposed Command tests against boarders.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.PUT_BACKS_INTO_IT: Challenging (+0) Intimidate or Charm. +5 to gunnery, repairs or firefighting this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.TRIAGE: Difficult (-10) Medicae. Cancels Crew Population damage from the previous turn.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.SILENT_RUNNING: Silent running: Speed is halved and every manoeuvre test is one step harder. Firing any weapon gives the ship away.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.ADJUST_BEARING: The ship may turn after moving {n} VU less than its Speed; it must still move at least 1 VU before turning.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.ADJUST_SPEED: Movement this turn may be raised or lowered by up to {n} VU - never below 0, never to double Speed or more.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.ADJUST_SPEED_BEARING: Movement may change by up to {n} VU, and the ship may turn after moving {n} VU less than its Speed.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.COME_TO_NEW_HEADING: The ship may turn at half Speed and again at full Speed. Its gunnery suffers -20 this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.DISENGAGE: {n} degrees of success. The ship leaves combat if that beats every enemy ship within 20 VU on its Detection + Scrutiny test. Either way it may not fire this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.EVASIVE: All shooting at this ship suffers -{n} until the start of its next turn, and so does its own.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.ACTIVE_AUGURY: The GM reveals celestial bodies, phenomena and ships within {n} VU. Any ship running silent in that range is detected.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.AID_MACHINE_SPIRIT: +{n} to {stat} for the rest of this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.DISINFORMATION: Morale rises by {n} for the duration of the combat.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.EMERGENCY_REPAIRS: Repair crews set to work on {name}: done in {n} turn(s).
SHIP.ACTION_OK.FLANK_SPEED: The ship may move {n} additional VU this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.FOCUSED_AUGURY_0: Revealed: every Essential Component except auger arrays and void shields.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.FOCUSED_AUGURY_1: Revealed: every Essential Component except auger arrays and void shields, and every Weapon Component.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.FOCUSED_AUGURY_2: Revealed: every Essential and Weapon Component, plus auger arrays, void shields and every combat-related Component.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.FOCUSED_AUGURY_3: Revealed: every Component aboard the target ship.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.HOLD_FAST: {n} Morale damage from the previous turn is cancelled.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.JAM_COMMUNICATIONS: One ship within {n} VU cannot use vox or other non-psychic communication.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.LOCK_ON_TARGET: +{n} to the next weapon component fired this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.PREPARE_TO_REPEL: +{n} to opposed Command tests against boarders, for as long as this character keeps rallying the defence.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.PUT_BACKS_INTO_IT: +5 to {n} gunnery, repair or firefighting test(s) this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.TRIAGE: {n} Crew Population damage from the previous turn is cancelled.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.MANOEUVRE: The manoeuvre fails: the ship makes its default move - forward half or full Speed, then it may turn.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.DISENGAGE: The attempt to disengage fails. The ship still may not fire this turn.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.FLANK_SPEED_BURNOUT: Failed by two or more degrees: the engines are strained too hard and suffer an Engines Crippled critical hit.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.FIGHT_FIRE: Difficult (-10) Command. Puts out the fire in one burning component; only one team needs to succeed.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.BOARD: Hard (-20) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability, within 1 VU of the target, instead of shooting. The ships lock together.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.RAM: Hard (-20) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability, within 1 VU with the prow facing the target, instead of shooting.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.HIT_AND_RUN: Challenging (+0) Pilot test to reach a ship within 5 VU, -10 per point of its turret rating; then opposed Command against its troops.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.BOARDING_ROUND: Opposed Command between the ships' boarding leaders. Larger crew, stronger hull and turrets give bonuses.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.BREAK_FREE: Hard (-20) Operate (Voidship) + Manoeuvrability at the start of the turn. Failure gives -20 to the next opposed Command test.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.MUTINY_TEST: Challenging (+0) Command by the captain. Failure means a mutiny.
SHIP.ACTION_HINT.SUPPRESS_MUTINY: Opposed Command, Charm or Intimidate against the ringleader. Each skill has its own price.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.FIGHT_FIRE: The fire in {name} is brought under control.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.BOARD: The ships crash together, locked with {name}. Neither may manoeuvre or shoot; the boarding fight is resolved with opposed Command each turn.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.BREAK_FREE: The ship tears itself free of the boarding action.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.HIT_AND_RUN: The boarding craft reaches the target, and the raiders fight their way in.
SHIP.ACTION_OK.MUTINY_TEST: The crew holds. There is no mutiny.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.BOARD: The approach fails and the ships do not lock together. The Shooting Action is still given up.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.RAM: The ram misses. The Shooting Action is still given up.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.BREAK_FREE: The ship fails to break free and suffers -20 to its next opposed Command test.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.HIT_AND_RUN: The boarding craft is driven off and returns to its ship.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.HIT_AND_RUN_SHOT_DOWN: Failed by four or more degrees: the boarding craft is shot down. The character survives stranded in a crippled craft, or is killed, at the GM's discretion.
SHIP.ACTION_FAIL.MUTINY_TEST: The Command test fails: part of the crew rises against the captain. A mutiny has begun.
SHIP.DIALOG.NO_TARGETS: There is no other ship to target.
SHIP.NOTE.BOARDED_NO_FIRE: This ship is locked in a boarding action and cannot shoot.
SHIP.OPPOSED.LABEL: Opposed
SHIP.BOARDING.TITLE: Boarding Action
SHIP.BOARDING.NOT_BOARDED: This ship is not locked in a boarding action.
SHIP.BOARDING.NO_MANOEUVRE: Ships locked in a boarding action cannot manoeuvre or shoot.
SHIP.BOARDING.NO_PERMISSION: Could not mark {name} as boarded: you do not own it. Ask the GM.
SHIP.BOARDING.MORALE_CHECK: Morale check for the losing crew
SHIP.BOARDING.HOLDS: Morale check {roll} against {morale}: the crew of {name} fights on.
SHIP.BOARDING.SURRENDERS: Morale check {roll} against {morale}: the crew of {name} breaks and surrenders.
SHIP.BOARDING.STALEMATE: Neither side gains ground this turn.
SHIP.BOARDING.SIMULTANEOUS: Ships in a boarding action take their Strategic Turns together, last in the initiative order.
SHIP.RAM.TITLE: Ramming
SHIP.RAM.NO_HULL_TYPE: Set this ship's hull type: ramming damage depends on it.
SHIP.HIT_AND_RUN.TITLE: Hit and Run
SHIP.HIT_AND_RUN.WIN: The raiders wreak havoc. The GM picks one of the two critical results below, and the hull takes {n} damage.
SHIP.HIT_AND_RUN.LOSE: The raiders are forced back to their craft without causing any mayhem.
SHIP.MUTINY.TITLE: Mutiny
SHIP.MUTINY.CROSSED: Morale has fallen below {thresholds}. The captain must make a Command test or face a mutiny.
SHIP.MUTINY.AFTER_COMBAT: Morale fell below a mutiny threshold during the fighting. Now that combat is over, the captain must make a Command test.
SHIP.MUTINY.ENDS_COMMAND: Armsmen crush the riots and the mutiny ends, at a cost of {crew} crew and {morale} morale.
SHIP.MUTINY.ENDS_CHARM: The ringleaders are placated and the mutiny ends, but the crew now thinks its officers weak: -{morale} morale.
SHIP.MUTINY.ENDS_INTIMIDATE: Examples are made and the mutiny ends, at a cost of {crew} crew and {morale} morale.
SHIP.MUTINY.LOST: The mutineers win by three or more degrees. The characters lose control of the ship and had best flee.
SHIP.MUTINY.CONTINUES: The struggle for the ship goes on. Test again.
SHIP.FIRE.IGNITED_NOTE: {name} is on fire, and anyone inside is exposed to it. Unless the fire is brought under control this turn, it consumes the component and spreads.
SHIP.FIRE.VENTED_NOTE: {name} is vented into the void: the fire is out, but the component is now depressurised.
SHIP.FIRE.DEPRESSURISED_NOTE: {name} vents its air. Once it is gone, anyone still inside suffers the effects of vacuum; crew in void suits can keep using it.
SHIP.FIRE.SPREAD: The fire in {from} was not contained: the component is damaged and the blaze spreads to {to}.
SHIP.FIRE.BURNED_OUT: The fire in {from} was not contained and has nothing left to consume: the ship is a burned-out hulk.
SHIP.BOARDING.ALREADY_FOUGHT: The boarding fight has already been resolved this round: locked ships take their turns together and make one opposed Command test.
VEHICLE.JINK_TOO_SLOW: Jink needs the vehicle to have moved at least its Tactical Speed last round (Walkers are exempt).
VEHICLE.JINK_NEGATED: The vehicle twists aside: {hits} hit(s) from the attack are negated.
VEHICLE.JINK_FAILED: The vehicle fails to twist out of the line of fire — the attack lands as rolled.
VEHICLE.EXTINGUISH_NO_CREW: Nobody is aboard to fight the fire — select the crewman's token or seat someone in the vehicle.
VEHICLE.EXTINGUISH_NOT_ON_FIRE: The vehicle is not on fire.
VEHICLE.EXTINGUISH_OK: {name} beats the flames out. The vehicle stops burning and is left Fire Damaged (−10 to Operate).
VEHICLE.EXTINGUISH_FAIL: {name} fails to smother the flames — the vehicle keeps burning.
VEHICLE.CREW_BURNING: Crew and passengers suffer −20 to every Test while the vehicle burns.
